verdict.rationale: Hightouch Events stores collected events in the customer's own warehouse, and syncs map warehouse models to any of 300+ destinations. That implies a new destination can be fed historical data by building a model over the stored events and creating a new sync. CDC behavior (diffing against the previous run) suggests a first run sends the full result set, but no doc explicitly describes replay, backfill, or full-resync functionality. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented replay/backfill or full-resync feature, documented recovery after a pipeline break, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
